title: HyperBlocker: Accelerating Rule-based Blocking in Entity Resolution using GPUs
gpu_scope: GPU-accelerated rule-based blocking for entity resolution via a pipelined CPU/GPU architecture; 6.8x/9.1x faster than prior CPU-distributed and GPU-based ER systems.
notes: Covers the blocking task exactly; the resolution task's match-clustering stage is not addressed by this artifact and has no dedicated GPU paper of its own.
